name: EDC Picks (non-ferrous)
description: Standard steel picks are ferromagnetic and will trigger metal detector portals and handheld wand searches. Titanium and G10 composite picks are non-ferrous and do not trigger standard magnetic metal detection, making them suitable for EDC in environments where screening may be encountered. Note that advanced security screening — millimeter wave, X-ray, or high-sensitivity detectors — may still detect picks based on shape or density. No EDC pick set should be considered universally undetectable.

blue.det: Non-ferrous picks do not trigger metal detectors; visual inspection or X-ray required for detection.
blue.cm: X-ray screening of bags; pat-down required for high-security areas; metal detectors alone are insufficient — non-ferrous picks are specifically designed to bypass them.
